argv: MATCH (m:Metric {key: 'repeat_purchase_rate_90d'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (m)-[:HAS_DIMENSION]->(d:Dimension) OPTIONAL MATCH (k:Constraint)-[:CONSTRAINS]->(m) OPTIONAL MATCH (m)-[:COMPUTED_FROM]->(t:Table) RETURN m, collect(DISTINCT d) AS dims, collect(DISTINCT k) AS caveats, collect(DISTINCT t) AS tables

m.name: Repeat-purchase rate (90d)
m.description: Share of customers with a second purchase within 90 days of their first.

dims.name: Product category
dims.description: Top-level product category of the first purchase.

caveats.statement: Walk-in retail lines often have NULL customer_id; B2B always has one. Denominator is customers with a first purchase, so NULL-customer lines are excluded — state this.

tables.description: One row per basket line; net_amount is booked (gross of returns).
Loyalty customers; walk-ins are not present.
